name: Jiangsu Sidike New Materials Science & Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Sidike New Materials Science & Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of multifunctional coating composite materials in China and internationally. It offers functional films, such as precision protective films and releasing materials; tapes and adhesives, including double-sided, optical clear adhesive, explosion-proofing films, single-sided tapes, mylar tapes, and conductive/shielding tapes; thermal management materials comprising graphite and graphene materials; polymer film materials; and packaging materials.
